title: Cardiomyopathy: hypertrophic, ischemic or unspecified
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's cardiomyopathy (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for cardiomyopathy.

HPI
Pt is an 80-year-old female presenting for routine follow-up of nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Pt reports feeling well today. Denies any episodes of syncope, palpitations, or shortness of breath on exertion. No chest pain reported. Pt stable on current regimen. She reports adherence to medications and no side effects.

Medication List
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Amlodipine 5mg daily
- Simvastatin 20mg daily

Review of Systems
Constitutional: No fatigue, no fever, no weight change.
CV: No palpitations, no chest pain, no syncope.
Resp: No SOB, no cough.
MSK: No joint pain.
Neuro: No dizziness, no numbness.
GI: No nausea, no diarrhea.

Social History
Pt lives at home with spouse. Retired. Non-smoker. No alcohol use.

Family History
Mother had coronary artery disease. Father had stroke at age 75.

Vitals
BP: 128/78
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 98% on RA
Weight: 145 lbs

Recent Labs
eGFR: 65
HbA1c: 6.2%
LDL: 88 mg/dL
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, pleasant.
CV: RRR, S1, S2 noted. No murmurs, rubs, or gallops. Cap refill <2s.
Lungs: CTAB.
Ext: No edema, pulses 2+ bilaterally.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3. Normal gait.

Assessment
1. Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Pt is currently asymptomatic and stable.

Plan
1. Continue current medications.
2. Cardiology to monitor yearly per previous echocardiogram findings.
3. Follow up in 6 months for routine evaluation.

Electronically signed,
T. Haddad, NP
May 14, 2026
explanations: Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: I42.2, other hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCC 227).
